decision.text: Intended — API check is enough. The Agency picker may still offer an inactive credential, because selecting it is refused on save with "Every auto-reissue credential must exist and be active".

observationDetail.title: Agency Auto Reissue picker still offers a supplier credential that has been made inactive
observationDetail.preconditions: AGN9780 (under BRN265) had supplier NDCsbr with PCC credential 313 "NDCSabre staging" and Auto Reissue on with 313 selected. Credential 313 was then set Inactive in Master → Supplier → Supplier Credentials (by account odeysysadmin, which has the Deactivate action).
observationDetail.steps: 1. Deactivated credential 313 (odeysysadmin). 2. Opened AGN9780 for edit (Mohamed Soliman). 3. Read Auto Reissue, the saved selection and the PCC tabs. 4. Opened Auto Reissue Credentials and read the options. 5. Left without saving. Repeated on two more fresh loads in a second inactive window, and compared with BRN265.
observationDetail.expected: Per spec §4 (read-time clean-up) and the TC-AGENCY-092 Expected Result, a selected credential that has become inactive is removed and is no longer offered: the Auto Reissue picker should not list "NDCSabre staging" while credential 313 is inactive, and Auto Reissue should stay ticked.
observationDetail.actual: The saved selection was cleaned correctly (reissueCredentials became []) and Auto Reissue stayed ticked, but the Agency picker still offered ["Sabre Staging","NDCSabre staging"], and the Agency's NDCsbr PCC tab still showed "NDCSabre staging". In the same window the Branch BRN265 hid both (picker ["Sabre Staging"], no NDCsbr tab), and the API refused the credential on save (400 "Every auto-reissue credential must exist and be active", TC-AGENCY-070).
observationDetail.impact: An Agency user can select an inactive credential in the picker and only learns it is invalid when the save is refused with an API error. The Agency and Branch screens behave differently for the same credential, and the Agency PCC tab keeps showing a credential that can no longer be used.
observationDetail.reproducibility: Always (3 of 3 observations, two separate inactive windows: 17:37 and 17:41 UTC)
observationDetail.component: Update Agency form — Auto Reissue Credentials picker and the Airline Supplier credential (PCC) tab options (Agency side only)
observationDetail.rca: Likely the Agency form builds its PCC and Auto Reissue options from the Agency's own stored PCC selection without filtering by credential status, while the Branch form uses a status-filtered supplier-credential list. Based on the observed behaviour only; not confirmed in code.
observationDetail.conclusion: The Update Agency form offers an inactive supplier credential in Auto Reissue Credentials (and in the PCC tab); the Branch form and the API correctly exclude it.
observationDetail.severityReason: A validation inconsistency that lets the user pick an option the backend rejects; no invalid data is saved, because the API blocks it.
